decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate builds directly on the firm's agricultural crate and injection-moulding knowledge, so several harvest seasons of feedback can be absorbed and used in-house to refine it as a flagship product.
Foldable large containers sit at the core of the firm's automotive and industrial expertise, so their results are easy to read and improve, and the multi-model line keeps strong commercial value.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends established pallet engineering for pooling and industrial customers, so it fits the firm's knowledge base and can be adjusted through its own engineering.

The spill-retention pallet is a niche safety product, but it relies on related pallet-moulding know-how, so the firm can still interpret demand and keep it at low cost, though the risk of withdrawal is higher.
The pallet with load retainers is a modest variant of existing pallets that the firm absorbs easily, so keeping it costs little even though it could eventually be folded into the wider pallet range.
